messages:
Nina - CSM: Heads-up: client DeltaLabs reported degraded latency during onboarding test window. Need quick SLO check and credit exposure estimate.
Rahul - CS Ops: Noted. Which endpoints and when?
Nina - CSM: /v1/embed and /v1/generate between Tue 10:10-10:40 UTC. p95 jumped to ~1.4s, saw a 9-minute partial availability dip.
Sam - Solutions Eng: I glanced at routing logs: spike in sequence length + concurrent warmups. Might be their concurrency settings.
Nina - CSM: They said they used the sample load test with concurrency=40. Onboarding docs didn't call out a recommended cap.
Cara - RevOps: Contract uptime 99.9% for onboarding period. If downtime >10m we usually trigger a review for one-off credit. Need exact minutes below threshold.
Rahul - CS Ops: OnboardBot created INC-8822 and I'm running per-account SLO query now.
OnboardBot: INC-8822 created and assigned to eng-runtime: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8822
Sam - Solutions Eng: Quick query returned downtime_min=9, latency_violations=3 in the onboarding window.
Cara - RevOps: 9 minutes is under the 10m onboarding trigger. We can offer a goodwill onboarding credit + enablement session without formal SLA credit. I'll draft numbers once Nina confirms customer ask.
Nina - CSM: I'll draft the customer-facing note: timeline, measurements, proposed goodwill credit, and a short enablement invite on batching/limits. Will post for review by EOD.
Rahul - CS Ops: I'll attach traces and a Grafana snapshot to INC-8822 and propose a doc change to add recommended concurrency caps.
Sam - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare a 20m enablement deck covering client-side concurrency, batch sizes, and warmup snippets.
Nina - CSM: Good. Setting renewal_risk = 'low' for now but will monitor after enablement and credit. :thumbsup:
